lane: PLAN AND HOME (Home, Agenda, Brief, Radio, Markets, House, Social, Links)

features.name: Home's Today card
say: what do I need to do today
features.does: Shows what is left in your diary today, and your to-dos due today even when the diary can't be read.

features.name: The hour's thing
features.where: ASK → Home, in the Map, Eye, Orbit, Grown-up and One Ink looks
features.does: Lights up the one thing that matters this hour; with nothing else next, the to-do due today.

features.name: Home in seven looks
features.where: Settings → The look → Scan, Map, Eye, Orbit, Grown-up, One Ink or Glass
features.does: The same Home drawn seven ways, every key 44 pt and nothing cut at the largest text.

features.name: Diary (next 14 days)
say: what's on my agenda today and tomorrow?
add dinner with Sam on Friday at 7
features.does: Your own events and your connected calendars, with a countdown to what is next and the phone's copy when the brain is out of reach.

features.name: Change or remove an event
features.where: PLAN → AGENDA → Diary → tap an event
features.does: Opens an event whole; one of your own can be renamed, moved or removed, with UNDO.
features.note: There is no true edit on the brain, so a change is a delete then an add (said honestly); no all-day switch or reminder choice in the change box.

features.name: Add an event in your words
features.does: Type it the way you'd say it and it is read into a day and time.

features.name: Month view
features.does: This month and next as a calendar: a dot for events, a ring for to-dos due, today lit; tap a day to see it.
features.note: Only this month and next (what the diary reads); no week or day timeline yet.

features.name: This week strip
features.where: PLAN → AGENDA → Diary → under the month
features.does: Monday to Sunday, each day with what it holds.

features.name: To-do list
say: add buy milk to my to-do list
features.does: To-dos with a day, a star, repeats, views (All, Today, Upcoming, Starred), editing and UNDO, kept on this phone.
features.note: It is a second list beside WORK's to-do list (kept in the brain); the two are not joined yet.

features.name: Reminders and tasks
say: remind me at 6 to call mum
features.does: Reminders that go off on time and tasks Ghosty runs on a schedule, with RUN NOW and UNDO.

features.name: Notifications inbox
features.does: Everything I told you while you were away, with MARK ALL READ and NOTIFY THIS DEVICE.

features.name: Connected calendars
features.does: Paste a calendar's private iCal link (steps for Google, Outlook, iCloud); read-only, stored encrypted.

features.name: Spending from a statement
say: how much did I spend on food?
features.does: Add a bank statement file and see the month sorted: categories, budgets, subscriptions.

features.name: Watchers
features.does: Things you asked me to keep an eye on, told back on their morning.

features.name: The Brief
features.does: Your day at a glance: weather with rain timing, what's left in the diary, to-dos due, the commute, money nudges, headlines.

features.name: Evening look-ahead
features.does: In the evening it says tonight, then tomorrow: range, rain, what to wear, sunrise.

features.name: What to wear
features.does: From the forecast only: warmth, feels-like, rain, wind, sun.

features.name: Read it to me / Brief me
features.where: ASK → Brief → READ IT TO ME or BRIEF ME
features.does: Speaks the Brief, or asks the chat for a 90-word spoken briefing from the same facts.

features.name: Headlines
features.does: Top stories with their source and time; when the feed is down it says so with TRY AGAIN.

features.name: Commute line
features.does: Home to work with live traffic, once both places are saved in Memory → ME → PLACES.

features.name: Radio stations
features.does: Search free internet radio by name, kind of radio or country, your country first.

features.name: Now playing
features.does: The station on air with PAUSE, STOP, TRY AGAIN and TRY ANOTHER, and why it won't play in plain words.

features.name: Sleep timer
say: how long until the radio stops
features.does: 15–90 minutes, an hour, or the end of this hour; fades out, then stops; shown on the lock screen.
features.note: A reload ends it (and says so); not shown in the top bar.

features.name: Favourites in your order
features.does: Star stations and put them in your own order, kept on the phone.

features.name: Recent stations
features.does: The last eight stations you played, one tap away.

features.name: Near me
features.does: Your country's stations first (the UK unless you change it).

features.name: Lock screen and AirPods
features.where: Lock screen while the radio plays
features.does: Play, pause, stop and next/previous through your favourites or recent stations.

features.name: Music by chat
features.does: Many ways of saying it all reach the radio.

features.name: Crypto prices
features.does: Your watched coins with today's move and a little chart, always with when they were read; never advice.

features.name: Your watchlist
features.does: Add any coin from CoinGecko's free search, reorder or remove with UNDO.

features.name: Your coins (holdings)
features.does: What you hold and what it is worth now in your currency, with today's change; your own numbers on the phone.

features.name: A coin's ranges
say: how has bitcoin done this year?
features.does: 24 H, 7 D, 30 D and 1 Y charts with highs and lows, and what you have of it.

features.name: Gold, silver and currencies
features.where: PLAN → MARKETS → Gold & silver, What £1 buys
features.does: Metal prices per ounce and what a pound buys abroad.

features.name: Converter
features.does: Converts money with the rates already read.

features.name: Ask why it moved
features.where: PLAN → MARKETS → tap a coin → ASK WHY IT MOVED
features.does: Asks the chat what happened, never whether to buy or sell.

features.name: Stocks and indices
features.does: Shares, the FTSE and oil.
features.note: Not built: the free source now needs a key.

features.name: The house, room by room
features.does: Every thing in your own Home Assistant as a card with its control.
features.note: Needs your free Home Assistant linked in SYSTEM → KEYS.

features.name: Whole house at a glance
features.does: Lights on, the heating, doors and windows open and for how long, what isn't answering.

features.name: Scenes and scripts
features.does: Your own scenes on one tap; a scene that sets a lock asks your confirm.
features.note: A script runs on one tap with no confirm (the phone can't see inside it).

features.name: Pins and ALL OFF
features.where: MAKE → HOUSE → ☆ on a card, ALL OFF on a room
say: turn everything off in the kitchen
features.does: Pin things to the top; ALL OFF turns off a room's lights, fans and TVs, never a lock.

features.name: Guarded things
features.does: Locks, alarms, garage doors and gates ask your confirm every time; nothing runs on a schedule.

features.name: The queue (APPROVE)
features.does: Every draft waits for your APPROVE · EDIT · NO; nothing goes out without your tap.

features.name: Write a post
features.where: ME → SOCIAL → Waiting → Write a post
features.does: One post for several accounts at once, each its own draft and its own APPROVE; a picture with its words; kept while you type.

features.name: Sent today
features.does: What your APPROVE sent, with links.

features.name: Your accounts
features.does: Bluesky, Mastodon, Discord and your Telegram channel, linked once each with plain steps; UNLINK says if it fails.

features.name: Follow and unfollow
features.does: Follow drafts with APPROVE.
features.note: Only from the chat; the screen can't make a follow draft yet.

features.name: Father and the origin
features.does: Who made me, when and what I promise.

features.name: Connections
features.does: Email, Spotify, Telegram, this phone and your keys, each saying where it stands in plain words.

features.name: Test a connection
features.does: Spotify, Telegram and keys can be tested; a failed check is never shown as working.
features.note: Email has no TEST yet (it needs a new brain route).

features.name: This phone
features.does: Notifications, install to the Home Screen and permissions, with the iPhone's steps.

upward.why: No more two lists: the Agenda, WORK, the Brief, Home and the chat all read and change the same list.
upward.builds_on: Agenda TO-DO and WORK's to-do list in the brain

upward.idea: A day timeline in the Agenda
upward.why: See today and tomorrow as hours with free gaps, like the best calendar apps.
Change an event's time, end, place, reminder and all-day in place, without delete-then-add.
upward.builds_on: Diary's change box and the brain's agenda route

upward.idea: To-dos with a time and their own alert
upward.why: 'Call the bank at 3' rings at 3 like a reminder, then ticks off.
Find any event, to-do or reminder by a word.

upward.idea: Brief that learns your morning order
upward.why: Puts what you open first at the top, from what you actually tap (kept on the phone).

upward.idea: Radio sleep timer that survives a reload
upward.why: Re-arms after a reload and plays on with one tap, said honestly.

upward.idea: Station detail and a now-playing song line
upward.why: Shows codec, quality and homepage, and the song title where the station sends it.
upward.builds_on: Radio's now playing and station rows

upward.idea: Price alerts while the app is open
upward.why: 'Tell me if bitcoin drops 5%' says it on screen when it happens, never advice.
A simple line of what your coins were worth day by day, from your own amounts.
What turned on, opened and changed today, as a timeline.
Make a scene on the phone from things you pick ('Goodnight: these lights off, heating 18'), confirms for locks kept.

upward.idea: Social: follow drafts on the screen
upward.why: Follow and unfollow from the screen, each waiting for APPROVE.
upward.builds_on: Write a post and the queue

upward.idea: Links: Email TEST and a health line
upward.why: Test email like Spotify, and one line saying everything is healthy or the one thing to fix.

upward.idea: Home: the next thing at a glance in every look
upward.why: One unified 'next' card across all seven looks from the same facts.
upward.builds_on: Home's Today card and the hour's thing

sideways.why: Shared with the kitchen's list, ticked in the shop.
sideways.builds_on: To-do list and the kitchen's shopping list

sideways.why: Daily habits with streaks, kept on the phone.
'Days until the holiday' on Home and in the Brief.

sideways.idea: Birthdays from your own people list
sideways.why: Never miss one: shown in the Brief the week before.
Subscribe by link, play like the radio, downloads only on your tap on Wi-Fi with the size said.
sideways.builds_on: The radio player and Media Session

sideways.idea: Alarm clock that plays a station
sideways.why: Wake to your favourite station (while Ghosty is open), with a gentle fade-in.
Before a trip: rates, what things cost there, from free rates already read.

sideways.idea: Energy use from your own meter
sideways.why: Read your smart meter or Home Assistant energy sensors and show today's use in words.
Rain timing and what to wear for each place you've saved.

sideways.idea: Bin day and household chores on the Agenda
sideways.why: Chores as repeating to-dos, bins from the home pack.
A morning line of what's new on your own timelines (read-only, nothing posted).
Lay out the week's events and to-dos and suggest free slots, all on the phone.

cross.why: A line with last night's sleep and today's water goal in the morning.

cross.idea: Agenda to-dos from WORK and MONEY
cross.why: Renewals, bills and work jobs become to-dos with their due days, one list.

cross.idea: Lens scans a poster or ticket into the Agenda
cross.why: Point at a gig poster or ticket and the event lands in the diary.
Today's events with a place drawn on the map (no live GPS sent to the brain).
A fun comic strip made from your own week's events, to keep or share with APPROVE.

cross.idea: Voice: 'goodnight' does the house, the radio timer and tomorrow's brief
cross.why: One phrase: lights off (with confirms), radio sleep timer, tomorrow's first event said.
